author: /root/dependency_inventory
scope: All 34 delivered new Lean files in the second-batch 30 task directories and their actual direct source imports. Time-stamped source inventory/installation suggestions only; no compilation or full transitive closure.
resolution_policy: Extract actual direct import declarations while ignoring comments/strings. Check candidate hashes against exact registry source records.
Prefer each candidate registry exact path/SHA pins and cross-check duplicate pins from all cohort users.
Use exact pinned paths or deterministic production module paths; never search/select a held draft by same-name matching.
AMBIGUOUS denotes non-unique exact candidates; MISSING denotes absent local source; PIN_MISMATCH prevents selection of unverified bytes.
External package revision comes from the manifest; absent Mathlib files have null source hashes and MISSING status. No external source is fetched/copied.
not_performed: No Lean/lake/compiler/numerical checker execution or repair, installation, copy, Git operation or quota inspection.
No modification to first-batch files, author files or production source.
No recursive dependency closure, external API/theorem/axiom audit or kernel credit.
